SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS mentor,
  COUNT(me.id) AS mentees
FROM iam.mentors mt
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = mt.telegram_id
LEFT JOIN iam.mentees me ON me.mentor_id = mt.id
GROUP BY u.name, u.username
ORDER BY mentees DESC

SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS mentor,
  COUNT(m.id) AS meetings
FROM meetings.meetings m
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = m.mentor_telegram_id
WHERE m.mentor_telegram_id IS NOT NULL
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY u.name, u.username
ORDER BY meetings DESC

SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS "Ментор",
  ROUND(AVG(a.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS "Средняя оценка",
  COUNT(DISTINCT ss.id) AS "Опросов"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
JOIN surveys.survey_answers a ON a.session_id = ss.id
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = ss.context_id::int
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = m.mentor_telegram_id
WHERE a.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.context_type = 'meeting'
GROUP BY u.name, u.username
ORDER BY "Средняя оценка" DESC

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', m.scheduled_at) AS time,
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM meetings.meetings m
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = m.mentor_telegram_id
WHERE m.mentor_telegram_id IS NOT NULL
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
